svg.title: Adalet Agent
svg.desc: Adalet Agent — Turkish civil law · live demo. Multi-agent legal assistant grounded in the statute: fabricated citations are dropped, unmatched claims are flagged as unverified. 159k legal vectors (8 areas of law); 84.4% correct article (32 live cases); 1.8k tests (80% cov. gate). Stack: FastAPI, LangGraph, Qdrant, React.
